annotations.title: Get Trustpilot reviews and company rating

description: Trustpilot reviews for one or more companies (rating, title, text, reviewer, country, date, company reply) plus the company's TrustScore and review counts. Filter by stars, language, verified and date period. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/trustpilot-reviews on your Apify account (about $0.0005 per review; company profile free; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

companies.description: Company domains or Trustpilot URLs, e.g. "apify.com".

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_reviews.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 500). Cost scales with this.

sort.description: Newest reviews first (recency) or most relevant first.

star_ratings.description: Only these ratings, e.g. ["1","2"] for complaints.

name: get_trustpilot_reviews

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Get Trustpilot reviews and company rating
